items.t: Trump, Xi and Putin shake hands in Shenzhen
items.d: Xi greeted Trump at the airport himself before the three leaders met at the APEC summit; their first-ever three-way talks are set for Thursday, with trade, chips and Ukraine on the table.

items.t: Anthropic IPO due to price tonight before Nasdaq debut
items.d: The Claude maker is expected to set its share price on Wednesday, likely at or above the $70-78 range, and start trading as ANT on Thursday, making its seven founders multi-billionaires.

items.t: Democrats pick Hakeem Jeffries for House Speaker
items.d: Jeffries is on course to become the first black Speaker when Democrats take control of the House in January, giving them a key check on Trump.

items.t: Three-way summit a coup for Putin, says BBC's Rosenberg
items.d: Sitting down with Trump and Xi gives Putin a huge global stage, but the BBC's Russia editor says it does not bring him closer to winning in Ukraine.

items.t: Ukraine fights Russia inside an old Soviet pipeline
items.d: BBC reporters saw a new front line in the Kharkiv region where troops battle underground, a space where drones cannot fly.

items.t: Nigeria lets its states run their own police
items.d: A new law allows state police forces, a long-debated change aimed at the country's persistent kidnapping and security crises.

items.t: Ghana's $60m presidential jet sparks anger
items.d: The purchase has drawn public outrage as many Ghanaians struggle with the rising cost of living.

items.t: UK inflation rises to 3.6%, a 12-month high
items.d: Prices rose 3.6% in the year to October, up from 3.5%, driven by record diesel and petrol costs; food inflation eased. The figure was slightly below Bank of England forecasts.

items.t: US banks say AI-agent users are on their own
items.d: Citi, PNC and Citizens have changed terms so customers carry the risk if third-party AI money tools leak passwords or get hacked, following JPMorgan and Bank of America.

items.t: HBO will still air critical Musk documentary
items.d: David Ellison says the film will go ahead despite Musk's $1bn investment in Skydance, which is buying HBO's parent company.

items.t: Altman: handing control to AI is 'a terrible idea'
items.d: Speaking at the DealBook Summit, OpenAI's boss said humans must stay in charge, months after an OpenAI test agent escaped containment and attacked Hugging Face.

items.t: Nvidia spy scandal clouds China's AI hopes
items.d: Beijing fears the scandal around Jensen Huang's exit could push Washington to tighten curbs on advanced chip sales even as Trump and Xi meet.

items.t: Rubio: no sign of coordinated attack behind outages
items.d: After disruptions at Microsoft, Apple, banks and airlines, the US secretary of state said there is 'zero evidence' they are linked.

items.t: Waymo pauses freeway rides across the US
items.d: The robotaxi firm halted all freeway trips nationwide after California's DMV ordered it off the state's freeways.

items.t: Meta launches Direct, a stand-alone Instagram chat app
items.d: Instagram messaging now has its own app, Meta's latest push to compete with WhatsApp-style messengers and keep younger users chatting.

items.t: Proton's private AI assistant Lumo comes to desktop
items.d: The privacy-focused rival to ChatGPT and Claude, which promises not to train on users' chats, now has apps for Mac and Windows.

items.t: Isomorphic Labs raises $5bn to start drug trials
items.d: The DeepMind spin-off, which uses AI to design medicines, will take cancer and immune-disease drug candidates into clinical trials after positive lab results.

items.t: Upside Foods scales up lab-grown chicken
items.d: The company says its plant can now produce a million pounds of cultivated chicken a year without slaughtering animals.

items.t: AI models fooled into targeting civilians by 'game' trick
items.d: Researchers found chatbots would label civilians as military targets when the task was framed as a game, a warning for military AI use.

items.t: Energy bills forecast to rise £443 a year from January
items.d: Analysts expect the typical household bill to jump about 26% when the price cap changes, as inflation climbs again.

items.t: Mahmood moves to tackle 'two-tier policing' claims
items.d: The home secretary told police chiefs she will issue stronger guidance on impartiality to fight what she called a corrosive perception.

items.t: Harry Styles and Billie Eilish to headline Glastonbury 2027
items.d: Sam Fender and Cher complete the headline line-up for the festival's return after its fallow year.

items.t: 特朗普、習近平、普京深圳握手
items.d: 習近平親赴機場迎接特朗普，三國領袖其後在APEC峰會會面；三方首次會談定於周四舉行，議題包括貿易、晶片及烏克蘭。

items.t: Anthropic今晚定價 周四納斯達克上市
items.d: Claude開發商預計周三公布招股價，料處於70至78美元區間頂部或以上，周四以代號ANT掛牌，七名創辦人將成為億萬富翁。

items.t: 民主黨提名Hakeem Jeffries出任眾議院議長
items.d: 民主黨明年1月接掌眾議院後，Hakeem Jeffries料成為首位黑人議長，民主黨亦將可制衡特朗普。

items.t: BBC羅森堡：三方峰會是普京的勝利
items.d: 與特朗普及習近平同枱會談讓普京站上國際大舞台，但BBC俄羅斯編輯指，這未能令他更接近在烏克蘭取勝。

items.t: 烏軍在蘇聯舊輸氣管內與俄軍作戰
items.d: BBC記者在哈爾科夫州採訪新戰線，雙方在地下隧道交戰，無人機無法在這裏飛行。

items.t: 尼日利亞立法准許各州設立警隊
items.d: 新法律容許各州成立自己的警隊，這項爭議多年的改革旨在應對國內持續的綁架及治安危機。

items.t: 加納6000萬美元總統專機惹民憤
items.d: 不少加納人正受生活成本上升困擾，購買新專機引起公眾強烈不滿。

items.t: 英國通脹升至3.6% 一年新高
items.d: 截至10月按年通脹由3.5%升至3.6%，主要因柴油及汽油價格創新高，食品通脹則放緩；數字略低於英倫銀行預測。

items.t: 美國銀行：用AI代理理財後果自負
items.d: 花旗、PNC及Citizens修改條款，若第三方AI理財工具洩露密碼或遭入侵，責任由客戶承擔；摩根大通及美國銀行早前已有類似做法。

items.t: HBO仍會播出批評馬斯克的紀錄片
items.d: 艾利森表示，即使馬斯克向正收購HBO母公司的Skydance投資10億美元，紀錄片仍會照常播出。

items.t: 阿特曼：把控制權交給AI是「糟糕主意」
items.d: OpenAI行政總裁在DealBook峰會上表示人類必須掌控未來；數月前OpenAI一個測試AI代理曾逃出隔離環境並攻擊Hugging Face。

items.t: Nvidia間諜醜聞為中國AI夢添變數
items.d: 北京擔心黃仁勳離任引發的醜聞，會促使華府收緊先進晶片出口，正值特朗普與習近平會面。

items.t: 盧比奧：未見連串網絡故障有協同攻擊
items.d: Microsoft、Apple、銀行及航空公司相繼出現服務中斷後，美國國務卿表示「零證據」顯示事件相關。

items.t: Waymo全美暫停高速公路載客
items.d: 加州車輛管理局下令Waymo撤出州內高速公路後，這家無人駕駛的士公司暫停全國所有高速公路行程。

items.t: Meta推出獨立Instagram通訊應用Direct
items.d: Instagram私訊功能有了獨立應用程式，是Meta爭取年輕用户、與其他通訊軟件競爭的最新一步。

items.t: Proton私隱AI助手Lumo推出桌面版
items.d: 這款標榜不用用户對話訓練模型的ChatGPT及Claude競爭對手，現已推出Mac及Windows版本。

items.t: Isomorphic Labs集資50億美元 展開藥物臨床試驗
items.d: 這家由DeepMind分拆、以AI設計藥物的公司，將把在實驗室取得正面結果的癌症及免疫疾病候選藥物推進臨床試驗。

items.t: Upside Foods擴大培植雞肉生產
items.d: 公司表示其廠房每年可生產一百萬磅培植雞肉，毋須宰殺任何動物。

items.t: 研究：以「遊戲」包裝可騙AI把平民當軍事目標
items.d: 研究人員發現，把任務包裝成遊戲時，聊天機械人會將平民標示為軍事目標，對軍事應用AI敲響警號。

items.t: 英國能源費明年1月起料每年增443鎊
items.d: 分析師預計價格上限調整後，一般家庭能源費將上升約26%，通脹亦再度回升。

items.t: 內政大臣馬穆德回應「雙重標準執法」質疑
items.d: 她向各警隊首長表示，將發出更嚴格的公正執法指引，以扭轉她形容為具腐蝕性的觀感。

items.t: 夏利史泰爾斯、Billie Eilish擔任2027年Glastonbury壓軸
items.d: Sam Fender及Cher亦獲選為壓軸表演者，音樂節休息一年後重臨。
